name: Custom Server (SteamCMD)
description: Install any dedicated server from Steam by app ID via SteamCMD (anonymous login), then start it with your own command. Great for games not yet in the blueprint library.

variables.label: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server app ID (e.g. 896660 for Valheim).

variables.label: Start command
variables.description: Executed in the install directory after SteamCMD finishes.

notes: SteamCMD is downloaded and managed automatically by Between the first time it is needed. If the app cannot be downloaded anonymously, sign in with a Steam account under Panel Settings → Steam and enable 'Install with the panel Steam account' in this server's settings.
